system_description.narrative_title: U.S.–Iran maritime strikes and sanctions trigger global energy shock
system_description.narrative_summary: A concentrated cycle of U.S. strikes on Iranian-linked tankers, Iranian threats to close or control Hormuz, and expanded sanctions is disrupting Gulf oil shipping and finance, sending diesel, gasoline and gas prices to multi-year highs and spilling into bond and equity markets. Treated as an open system, the story links flows (crude, refined fuels, shipping lanes, capital and sanctions-affected bank flows), actors (U.S., Iran, Gulf states, OPEC+, banks, insurers) and processes (military strikes, blockades, sanctions, market pricing, rerouting) with reinforcing and balancing feedbacks — higher prices amplify political pressure and economic pain, which in turn drives more coercive measures and market volatility. The dynamic is sensitive to external drivers (winter stocks, OPEC output choices, Russia/Ukraine war, central-bank moves) and to adaptive responses (alternate routes, insurance, sanctions evasion, diplomatic mediation).
system_description.scope: Maritime security in the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz; the oil-to-refined-fuel supply chain (production, tanker shipment, refining, distribution); sanctions and international banking/flows related to Iran; global commodity and financial market responses (oil, gas, diesel, bonds, equities); regional political and military actions directly affecting these flows.
system_description.super_system: Global geopolitical-economic system (world energy markets integrated with international security, finance and trade)
adjacent_subsystems: Regional Middle East security architecture and state diplomacy
Global oil & gas market coordination (OPEC+, LNG markets, storage/winter preparedness)
International finance, sanctions enforcement and banking networks
Global shipping, insurance and logistics infrastructure

variables.name: Maritime security risk
variables.description: Market and operational assessment of the probability and severity of hostile actions or disruptions to commercial vessels in key sea lanes.

variables.name: Crude oil shipments
variables.description: Volume rate of crude oil being loaded, transiting and delivered via maritime routes per unit time.

variables.name: Refined fuel shipments
variables.description: Volume rate of refined petroleum products being transported by sea from refineries to distribution points per unit time.

variables.name: Shipping lane congestion
variables.description: Degree to which vessel traffic approaches or exceeds optimal transit capacity in critical maritime channels.

variables.name: Tanker insurance cost
variables.description: Average premium level charged to insure tanker voyages through risk-prone maritime zones.

variables.name: Bank cross-border restriction
variables.description: Extent of formal and informal limits on cross-border banking transactions that affect commodity trade and payments.

variables.name: Sanctions evasion activity
variables.description: Rate of activities and transactions undertaken to circumvent economic restrictions and monitoring per unit time.

variables.name: Crude oil price level
variables.description: Market price per barrel for benchmark crude reflecting supply/demand and risk premia.

variables.name: Refined fuel price level
variables.description: Market price level for refined products (e.g., diesel, gasoline) incorporating margins and transport costs.

variables.name: Refinery utilization rate
variables.description: Share of total refining capacity actively processing crude into products at a given time.

variables.name: Spare production capacity
variables.description: Available incremental upstream production or refining capacity that can be brought online within a relevant timeframe.

variables.name: Winter fuel stocks
variables.description: Inventory level of fuel held in storage buffers intended for elevated seasonal consumption periods.

variables.name: Shipping rerouting rate
variables.description: Frequency or proportion of maritime voyages being diverted from primary routes to alternate paths per unit time.

variables.name: Maritime blockade degree
variables.description: Extent and intensity of formal or informal restrictions on vessel movements and port access in a region.

variables.name: Financial market volatility
variables.description: Magnitude of short-term fluctuations in asset prices and risk premia across commodity, bond and equity markets.

variables.name: Diplomatic engagement intensity
variables.description: Rate and intensity of formal diplomatic mediation, negotiations and crisis-management processes underway.

catalysts.title: Iran announces restricted zone in Gulf
catalysts.description: Iran to declare a new restricted maritime zone in the Gulf, legally restricting vessel movements and heightening regional control.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Iran says to announce new restricted zone in the Gulf in the coming days' — implies tightened maritime restrictions and risk.

catalysts.title: Escalation: further attacks on tankers and energy facilities
catalysts.description: Ongoing strikes and counter-strikes targeting oil tankers and energy infrastructure, sustaining supply disruptions and insurance/risk premia.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'US strikes three Iranian oil tankers'; 'Oil supertankers hit in Strait of Hormuz'; 'Saudi Aramco facility hit'.

catalysts.title: OPEC+ keeps output steady for October
catalysts.description: OPEC+ decision to maintain current production quotas for October, leaving market response to geopolitical supply shocks.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'OPEC+ set to hold oil output policy steady for October' — no extra supply cushion despite shocks.

catalysts.title: Sustained traffic disruption in Strait of Hormuz
catalysts.description: Continued dips in Hormuz transits and operational disruption reduce throughput and push vessels to reroute or delay voyages.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Hormuz traffic dips to lowest since May'; 'U.S.-Iran tanker war escalates as Hormuz disruption deepens'.

catalysts.title: Refiners prioritise products, looming ship-fuel shortage
catalysts.description: Refineries shift yields toward higher-margin products amid war strain, creating shortages of fuel oil/bunker fuels for shipping.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Ship fuel shortage looms as refiners strained by war favour other products'.

catalysts.title: Continued sanctions evasion through banks and intermediaries
catalysts.description: Ongoing flows of Iranian funds through banks and intermediary hubs sustain sanctions-evasion networks despite penalties.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'How Billions in Iranian Money Passes Through U.S. Banks'; 'US sanctions Turkish bank accused of enabling Iran'.

catalysts.title: Low European gas stocks raise winter supply risk
catalysts.description: Europe enters winter with below-average gas inventories, increasing sensitivity to LNG and oil-market shocks from Middle East.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'EU enters winter with lowest gas stocks on record'; 'European Gas Climbs on LNG Supply Concerns Ahead of Winter'.

catalysts.title: Push to refer Iran to UN Security Council via IAEA board
catalysts.description: Diplomatic move at the IAEA board could escalate multilateral pressure on Iran and trigger heightened sanctions/diplomatic activity.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'US and allies push IAEA board to report Iran to UN Security Council' — implies stepped diplomatic pressure and risks.
